title: Recording: Old Dirt Road, Scared, #9 Dream, Steel And Glass, Nobody Loves You (When You’re Down And Out) by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

Strings were added to five songs on John Lennon’s Walls And Bridges album on 20 August 1974.

The songs were ‘Old Dirt Road’, ‘Scared’, ‘#9 Dream’, ‘Steel And Glass’, and ‘Nobody Loves You (When You’re Down And Out)’. Of those, ‘#9 Dream’ was the only song left incomplete at the end of the session; it was finished on 26 August.
